Rechat is the operating system for real estate. Marketing, CRM, transactions, listings and AI in a single product, replacing the disconnected stack of tools most agents are forced to stitch together.

Some of the largest brokerages and networks in North America run their business on us, and tens of thousands of agents use Rechat every week. We have spent the last two years rebuilding the product to be AI-native, and we are growing quickly.

REMOTE (Work may be performed anywhere)

The Role

Tens of thousands of agents use Rechat. Their brokerage pays for their seat, and for most of them that is the entire commercial relationship we have with them.

We also build the premium products those same agents want: websites, AI-driven marketing, advertising and social. Those are worth many multiples of a seat, and almost none of our agents buy them today.

There is a second problem sitting next to the first. An agent cannot currently find Rechat, sign up, try it and start paying us on their own. There is no door. Every path in runs through a brokerage contract or a conversation with a person.

You are here to build both: the door, and the upgrade path behind it.

Any agent, anywhere, should be able to discover Rechat, sign up alone, reach something valuable quickly, and become a paying customer without ever speaking to us. And every agent already using Rechat should have an obvious, well-designed reason to pay us more.

Your remit is conversion, wherever it happens. Our demand team drives attention and traffic. From the moment an agent shows interest, it is yours: the landing page, the signup, the trial, the first valuable moment, the upgrade, the checkout. You own the percentage at every one of those steps.

And your other job is time to value. Every setup step between signing up and getting something useful costs us a percentage of the agents who signed up. Uploading a logo, choosing colours, configuring templates, importing contacts. Your job is to delete as many of those steps as possible, and to make the ones that remain fast enough that nobody abandons. An agent should reach something they would be sad to lose within their first session, not their first month.
Those two things, conversion and time to value, are what you are here to move. Everything below is in service of them.
That includes reaching agents proactively rather than waiting for them to log in. We have an AI assistant in the product, and one of the most interesting questions in this role is how much of the buying journey it can carry on its own.

This is the largest revenue opportunity in the company and nobody owns it today.

•
Touchless signup. Self-serve onboarding, trial mechanics, and the path from trial to paid. Engineers are working on this now and they need a product owner.

•
The conversion path outside the app. Pricing pages, plan comparison, signup and trial-start pages, and the experiments that improve them. Our demand team buys the traffic and runs campaign pages. You own the pages where interest turns into an account.

•
Checkout and billing. Card on file, self-serve purchase, upgrades, downgrades, failed payment recovery. Some of this does not exist yet and you will specify it.

•
The in-product upgrade path. Who sees a prompt, where in their workflow, what it says, what happens when they click, and how much completes without a human.

•
Seat-to-paid conversion. Turning agents on a brokerage-paid seat into agents paying us directly.

•
Proactive outreach that converts. Anything triggered by product behaviour: a trial ending, a limit reached, a feature explored, an account gone quiet. In-app, push, and behaviour-triggered email and SMS, including what our AI assistant does on its own initiative. Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o  maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal , reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: https://grupoquintoandar.com/

 

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• Nosso time atua no modelo híbrido , unindo a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto com a troca do presencial no nosso escritório em São Paulo - Vila Leopoldina, quando necessário. 

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

Operações é a linha de frente do QuintoAndar, os times que transformam nossa promessa em uma experiência real para os nossos clientes. Dentro do time de HRBP que apoia a área, você será responsável pela parceria com a maior equipe: cerca de 500 pessoas, onde a escala da agenda de gente é proporcional ao peso que ela carrega para o negócio. É um time em constante transformação. Processos evoluem, cargos mudam de escopo e novas competências são exigidas das pessoas que já estão aqui. Seu trabalho será co-desenhar como a organização precisa ser daqui a seis meses e ajudar a liderança a conduzir essa mudança sem perder boas pessoas e sem perder velocidade.

Suas Responsabilidades

•
Parceria com o negócio ( Business partnership ): Construir confiança suficiente com a liderança de Operações, de gerentes a diretores, para ser chamado antes da decisão, e não depois dela. Conhecer bem a operação: seus OKRs, seus números e onde ela trava. Manter 1:1s recorrentes e ocupar espaço nos fóruns de decisão da área. Dizer "não" e "ainda não" quando tiver argumentos para isso, inclusive para pessoas mais sêniores que você.

•
Design organizacional e gestão de mudança: Evoluir a estrutura da área, incluindo escopo de cargos, níveis hierárquicos, amplitude de controle ( span of control ), alocação de talentos e planejamento de capacidade ( capacity planning ). Conduzir mudanças com rigor na forma como são comunicadas e sequenciadas. Antecipar o impacto humano de mudanças de processos e tecnologia: quem precisa desenvolver o quê, onde estão os riscos de retenção e de quais perfis a área passará a precisar.

•
Talento e performance: Ter uma leitura própria e bem fundamentada sobre os talentos da área, desde sucessores e lacunas críticas até quem está pronto para o próximo passo e quem não está. Conduzir calibrações, ciclos de performance e sucessão com excelência, trazendo à tona o que for desconfortável quando necessário. Apoiar líderes em situações de baixa performance, conflitos, desligamentos e mudanças de escopo.

•
Dados e insights : Usar KPIs de Gente - como turnover , eNPS, performance, headcount , tempo de contratação ( time-to-fill ), ciclo de mérito e talent review - para formular hipóteses e embasar recomendações. Perceber padrões enquanto ainda há tempo de agir.

•
Projetos e rituais: Liderar iniciativas de Gente de ponta a ponta, desde a estruturação do problema até a entrega do resultado, incluindo projetos transversais. Conduzir os rituais do ciclo de gente em parceria com Desenvolvimento de Talentos, Atração de Talentos, Remuneração e Operações de Gente ( People Ops ).

Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.) | Federal Civilian Practice
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
A 20-year-old federal platform sits behind a home loan benefit that millions of American families depend on. Your job is to help retire it without anyone noticing.
You will own the DevSecOps and platform engineering ecosystem for a modernization program that runs legacy and modern stacks side by side: pipelines that move code from commit to production in under an hour, zero-downtime production deployments, environments built and torn down as code, and observability deep enough to explain a failure before the customer reports it. You will do this inside real federal security constraints, with real authority over how the engineering system works, and with AI as a first-class engineering tool.
The Opportunity
Most DevSecOps roles hand you an inherited pipeline and a backlog of tickets. This one hands you an engineering system to shape.
The program spans multiple applications, technology stacks, and platforms: a legacy suite that must stay stable and secure until it is decommissioned, and a modern cloud platform (Salesforce-centered, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud) where new capability lands every month. Production runs 24/7 against contractual availability targets. Releases ship to production at least monthly. Critical vulnerabilities must close in 30 days. The monitoring bar is full business transaction visibility, not “the server is up.”
You will lead the engineers who make all of that true. Not from a status meeting. From the architecture, the pipeline definitions, the incident bridge, and the customer conversation. You will decide how code moves from a developer's hands to production, how failures get detected and diagnosed, how security gets enforced without slowing delivery, and where automation and AI replace manual work.
The outcomes are measured, visible, and attached to a mission that matters. When deployments get faster and incidents get rarer, the customer sees it, and so do the people the program serves.
A note on the stack. If “Salesforce” made you hesitate, read this twice. You will not become a Salesforce administrator, and this role will not narrow your career. The application platform is Salesforce. The engineering system around it is not. The CI/CD architecture, environment automation, serverless cloud components, observability, security automation, legacy systems, and AI-enabled workflows are general-purpose platform engineering, and that is where you will spend your time. A strong platform engineer picks up the Salesforce-specific pieces quickly. The reverse is not true, which is why we are hiring for the former.
What You'll Own

• The delivery platform. Design and run CI/CD that lets teams move code from commit to production across multiple applications, stacks, and environments with minimal manual intervention. The standard: builds, tests, and deployments complete in under an hour, and production releases ship monthly or faster.
